title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 044
review_goal: Differentiate baseball, bed, and bedside table variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Baseball bat shape beside a small round ball near the upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a baseball bat with a separate round ball beside it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the stitched baseball when the icon should stay a simple round ball.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot pairs a slanted bat with a separate small ball instead of showing seam lines.

items.depicts_observation: Side view bed frame with one pillow inside one large blanket block
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a side view bed with a visible pillow and blanket block.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the front facing bed when the mattress should face the viewer directly.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the bed from the side with one pillow circle and one blanket rectangle.

items.depicts_observation: Front facing bed frame with one centered headboard panel and two short legs
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a bed seen from the front with the headboard above the mattress.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the side view bed when the pillow and blanket block should be seen in profile.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot faces the bed forward and stacks the headboard, mattress stripe, and two legs vertically.

items.depicts_observation: Bedside cabinet with a top drawer two door handles and two short feet
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a nightstand with one drawer above two cabinet doors.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two door bedside cabinet when the top drawer should not be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot clearly separates one top drawer from two lower doors with handles.

items.depicts_observation: Two door bedside cabinet with a flat top and two short feet
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a bedside cabinet made only from two doors under a flat top.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the drawer plus doors nightstand when a top drawer should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot removes the top drawer and keeps a simple two door cabinet shape.
